section: Telugu language and literature to the 14th century - Nannaya, Tikkana, Errana, Palkuriki Somanatha

accepted.s: The Telugu Mahabharata was completed over which of the following three historical eras?
o: Eastern Chalukya, Kakatiya and Reddi eras
Vijayanagara, Qutb Shahi and Asaf Jahi eras
accepted.x: The Telugu Mahabharata was completed over three successive eras: the Eastern Chalukya, Kakatiya and Reddi periods.
accepted.tq: Use the dynasty sequence to identify the correct historical span.

accepted.s: Which one of the following best explains the significance of Nannaya's contribution to Telugu literature?
o: He established the desi-metre tradition during the Vijayanagara period.
He introduced Persian vocabulary into Telugu court literature.
He fixed the grammar and literary register of classical Telugu and initiated the Kavitrayam tradition.
He was the first poet to compose a Telugu satakam.
accepted.x: Nannaya's Bharatam helped fix the grammar and literary register of classical Telugu and began the tradition of the Kavitrayam.
accepted.tq: Select the option that combines the stated literary contributions without adding an unrelated claim.

accepted.s:
Consider the following pairs:

1. Andhra Mahabharatamu — First Telugu book
2. Andhra Shabda Chintamani — First Telugu grammar, written in Sanskrit
3. Ganita Sara Sangraha — First Telugu mathematics book

Which of the pairs given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three pairs are correct. Andhra Mahabharatamu is identified as the first Telugu book, Andhra Shabda Chintamani as the first Telugu grammar in Sanskrit, and Ganita Sara Sangraha as the first Telugu mathematics book.
accepted.tq: Check each first independently before selecting the coded combination.

accepted.s: Telugu Language Day is observed on 29 August because it commemorates the birth anniversary of whom?
accepted.x: Telugu Language Day is observed on 29 August, the birth anniversary of Gidugu Venkata Ramamurthy.
accepted.tq: Match the commemorative date with the associated personality.

accepted.s:
With reference to the Telugu Language Day observances, consider the following statements:

1. Telugu Language Day is observed on 29 August.
2. Telugu Language Awards are also associated with 29 August.
3. The date is connected with the birth anniversary of Gidugu Venkata Ramamurthy.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. Telugu Language Day and the Telugu Language Awards are associated with 29 August, the birth anniversary of Gidugu Venkata Ramamurthy.
accepted.tq: When all statements describe closely linked aspects of one observance, verify the date, event and person together.

accepted.s: From 2026, the annual Telugu Mahotsavam in Andhra Pradesh is intended to be held:
o: Once every decade under the Archaeological Survey of India
Only on Telugu Language Day in alternate years
Once every five years during the World Telugu Conference
Every year as an annual Telugu cultural event
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh announced that Telugu Mahotsavam would be held every year from 2026.
accepted.tq: Distinguish an annual recurring programme from periodic conferences and commemorative events.

accepted.s: Who announced the annual Telugu Mahotsavam at the valedictory programme held at the Undavalli Caves?
o: The Director-General of the Archaeological Survey of India
accepted.x: Culture Minister Kandula Durgesh announced the annual Telugu Mahotsavam at the valedictory programme at the Undavalli Caves.
accepted.tq: Identify the office-holder associated with the announcement rather than the venue or implementing agency.

accepted.s: An Archaeological Survey of India survey in the Nallamala Tiger Reserve during 11–13 June 2026 copied how many inscriptions?
accepted.x: The ASI survey in the Nallamala Tiger Reserve copied 25 inscriptions dating from the 2nd to the 16th century CE.
accepted.tq: For numerical current-affairs questions, separate the exact count from the associated date and range.

accepted.s: The Telugu records identified during the ASI survey of the Nallamala Tiger Reserve date from which period?
accepted.x: The Telugu records found in the survey date from the 7th to the 16th centuries CE.
accepted.tq: Compare the competing chronological ranges carefully; the broader survey range and the Telugu-record range are different.

accepted.s: An eighth-century Telugu inscription was reported at which place?
accepted.x: An eighth-century Telugu inscription was reported at Pitikayagulla.
accepted.tq: Use location-based recall for an inscriptional discovery.

accepted.s:
Consider the following pairs relating to the early history of Telugu:

1. Nagabu — First Telugu word
2. Kalamalla — First Telugu inscription
3. Addanki — First poetic inscription

Which of the pairs given above are correct?
accepted.x: All the pairs are correctly matched: Nagabu is associated with the first Telugu word, Kalamalla with the first Telugu inscription, and Addanki with the first poetic inscription.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure location–fact pairs and verify all three early Telugu milestones.

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements correctly describes the linguistic and literary situation during the Kakatiya period?
o: Telugu grammar, poetics and the desi-metre tradition developed, although Sanskrit remained the inscriptional language.
Persian became the principal language of Kakatiya inscriptions.
Only Tamil was used for literary composition and inscriptions.
Telugu literature declined, while Sanskrit disappeared from inscriptions.
accepted.x: The Kakatiya era saw the development of Telugu grammar, poetics and the desi-metre tradition. Telugu literature flourished, while Sanskrit continued as the inscriptional language.
accepted.tq: Separate the language of literary development from the language retained in inscriptions.

accepted.s: Which of the following is correctly matched?
o: Andhra Bhasha Bhushanam — First Telugu Ramayana
accepted.x: Ranganatha Ramayanam is identified as the first Telugu Ramayana. Bhaskara Ramayanam is associated with the first Telugu champu, while Andhra Bhasha Bhushanam is associated with grammar.
accepted.tq: Discriminate among closely related literary firsts by matching each work with its genre or status.

accepted.s: Which one of the following represents the source-wise variation regarding the first Telugu Purana?
o: Andhra Mahabharatamu or Ganita Sara Sangraha
Andhra Shabda Chintamani or Andhra Bhasha Bhushanam
accepted.x: Different sources identify either Markandeya Puranam or Basava Puranam as the first Telugu Purana. The variation reflects differing criteria and traditions concerning literary 'firsts'.
accepted.tq: Read the wording closely where alternative traditions are expressly recognised instead of forcing a single answer.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about Krishnadevaraya and Telugu literary culture:

1. The line “Desa Bhashalandu Telugu Lessa” is associated with Krishnadevaraya.
2. The Ashtadiggajas are associated with the peak of Telugu literary culture during this period.
3. The Kakatiya period alone is identified with the Ashtadiggajas.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is false because the Ashtadiggajas are associated with the peak of Telugu literature during the Vijayanagara period, particularly under Krishnadevaraya.
accepted.tq: Reject the statement that transfers a famous literary group to the wrong historical period.

accepted.s: Tikkana Somayaji was the first Telugu poet to have a work dedicated to him. Which work was dedicated to him?
o: Ranganatha Ramayanam by Gona Budda Reddy
accepted.x: Ketana dedicated Dasakumara Charitra to Tikkana Somayaji, making Tikkana the first Telugu poet to have a work dedicated to him.
accepted.tq: Use the author–work–dedicatee relationship rather than confusing it with authorship of the major epics.

accepted.s: Telugu was recognised as a classical language of India in which year?
accepted.x: Telugu has been recognised as a classical language since 2008.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the exact recognition year from nearby milestone years.

accepted.s: The proposal to install a statue of Tikkana Somayaji was associated with which district?
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh discussed installing a statue of Tikkana Somayaji in SPSR Nellore district.
accepted.tq: Match the literary personality with the district linked to the current proposal.

accepted.s:
Arrange the following Telugu literary and inscriptional milestones in chronological order, beginning with the earliest:

A. Kalamalla inscription
B. Pitikayagulla eighth-century inscription
C. Addanki poetic inscription
D. Telugu records of the Nallamala survey extending to the sixteenth century
accepted.x: Kalamalla is dated to 575 CE, the Addanki poetic inscription belongs later, the Pitikayagulla inscription is from the eighth century, and the surveyed Telugu records extend up to the sixteenth century. Hence the order is A, C, B, D.
accepted.tq: Anchor the sequence with the known 575 CE date and the sixteenth-century end point, then place the eighth-century item carefully.

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT correctly matched?
o: Gidugu Venkata Ramamurthy — Birth anniversary commemorated on Telugu Language Day
Tikkana Somayaji — Birth anniversary commemorated on 29 August
accepted.x: Tikkana Somayaji is not associated with 29 August. The date marks the birth anniversary of Gidugu Venkata Ramamurthy and is observed as Telugu Language Day.
accepted.tq: Find the single mismatched personality–observance pair rather than accepting all familiar Telugu literary names.
